Material Calculator

Privacy policy

Material Calculator by JN86VI estimates material quantities. This policy describes the current offline preview and the external services you choose to use. Advertising, consent forms and in-app purchases are not active in this preview.

Calculations on your device

Paint, laminate flooring, wall and floor tiles, concrete, wallpaper, mulch, topsoil and gravel calculations run on your device. Measurements, surface names, deductions and results stay in the app session; there is no saved project or calculation history. The infinite wallpaper also works offline. No JN86 account, calculation server or automatic analytics service is used.

Saved products and settings

When you explicitly save a product, its name, material type, supplied parameters, units and a local record ID are stored in Android app-private storage. You can reuse, edit and delete these records offline. The selected app language and appearance are also stored locally. Unfinished edits are temporary session data, not saved products.

Retention and local deletion

Saved products remain until you delete them or clear the app data. Android app-data clearing or uninstalling removes the app’s local data. Temporary calculations and unfinished drafts can be lost when the app process ends. Separate Android backups are managed through your device and backup provider; local deletion does not guarantee deletion of those copies or of correspondence and payment records.

Android backup and restore

The app allows Android system backup and device transfer of saved product records and common settings. Measurements, results, unfinished drafts and animation state are excluded. Availability and timing depend on your Android version, device, backup settings and provider. Restored product data is validated before replacing local records. There is no JN86 cloud sync or manual file import/export feature, and no guarantee that every device completes a restore.

Permissions, diagnostics and security

The current preview requests no internet, advertising-ID, billing, camera, microphone, contacts or location permission. It contains no AdMob, UMP or Play Billing SDK and makes no app-owned network requests. Technical diagnostic messages stay in local logs; there is no JN86 crash-upload service. Your keyboard, Android backup service and browser operate under their own settings and privacy practices.

Planned advertising and purchases — not active

A later version is planned to use AdMob banners, UMP privacy choices and an optional one-time Google Play purchase that removes ads. All calculators and saved products will remain available without payment; no subscription is planned. No ad request, consent check or purchase is performed by the current preview. The actual SDK data handling, providers and choices will be documented before activation. Prices will come from Google Play, with no fixed fallback price.

Website, email and voluntary support

Privacy, website and Support links open an external browser at your request; sending email is also your choice. This website is hosted by GitHub Pages, which can process IP addresses and technical visit data. Browser storage remembers your selected language. If you email JN86VI, we and the email providers receive your address and message. We use them to answer your request on the basis of legitimate interests, then delete or anonymize them when no longer needed for follow-up, legal duties or claims.

Voluntary support through the JN86 website does not buy ad removal or any app benefit. PayPal can share transaction and contact details with the creator. Bitcoin transfers are public blockchain records that JN86 cannot erase. Any transaction information we receive is kept as necessary for accounting, tax obligations or legal claims. The selected payment or email provider applies its own policy.

Your choices and privacy contact

Use the saved-product deletion controls and Android app-data and backup settings for local records. For access, correction, deletion or other applicable privacy rights concerning information held by JN86VI, email the contact below. You may object to processing based on legitimate interests and complain to your data protection authority. There is no JN86 account to delete. Do not send sensitive measurements, passwords or payment details.

Privacy contact: JN86VI

Changes to this policy

This page is updated when data handling changes. The date above identifies the current policy. All eight language versions describe the same practices.

Service providers and further information

Android and your backup provider handle system backups. GitHub hosts this website; Microsoft Outlook and other email providers deliver correspondence. Payment providers handle voluntary support that you initiate on the website. Their notices explain their processing, retention, international transfers and privacy controls. These external services are separate from the planned in-app advertising and purchases.
